encyclopedia.summary: A long manga by Osamu Tezuka, serialised from 1972 to 1983. It sets the life of Siddhartha back down into an Indian society ruled by caste, famine and war. Rather than retelling scripture, Tezuka writes it as the story of a crowd of people carrying their own desires and fears.

key_facts.value: The life of Siddhartha and ancient India

highlights: Puts Siddhartha's life back into a society ruled by caste, famine and war.
A late long work by Tezuka that turns his characters' appetites into comedy.
It reads as a story about people rather than scripture.

related.note: Another long work by the same author on life and death

A civil engineering student wakes as Lloyd, heir to a ruined estate, and pulls it out of poverty with engineering knowledge. Drainage, roads and building materials do the work that magic usually does.

It turns the isekai premise's information advantage into visible business results.
Lloyd's face acting carries the comedy and the stakes at once.
